scripts.typecheck: bun --bun tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun run --filter @kalandra/website check
scripts.format: bun --bun prettier --write apps/website/src scripts tests apps/website/*.{json,js,ts} package.json tsconfig*.json .github/workflows/check.yml
scripts.format:check: bun --bun prettier --check apps/website/src scripts tests apps/website/*.{json,js,ts} package.json tsconfig*.json .github/workflows/check.yml
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
